note: People born in the Northern Mariana Islands are United States citizens; the United States issues no national identity card (6 U.S.C. § 554), so they hold none. Identity cards issued locally are of the state kind, with the driver's license.

sources.title: United States Code, 2023 edition (govinfo.gov), 48 U.S.C. § 1801 and note, the Covenant to Establish a Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands
sources.said: Section 303. All persons born in the Commonwealth on or after the effective date of this Section and subject to the jurisdiction of the United States will be citizens of the United States at birth.

sources.title: LII, 6 U.S. Code § 554, National identification system not authorized (Pub. L. 107-296, title XV, § 1514)
sources.said: 6 U.S. Code § 554 - National identification system not authorized ... Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to authorize the development of a national identification system or card.
